{{short description|French mathematician and economist}}
{{use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=April 2020}}
'''Monique Jeanblanc-Picqué''' (born 1947){{r|born}} is a French mathematician known for her work in [[mathematical finance]]; other topics in her research have included [[control theory]] and [[probability theory]]. She is a [[professor emerita]] at the [[University of Évry Val d'Essonne]].{{r|bfs}}

==Education and career==
Jeanblanc was a student at the [[École normale supérieure Paris-Saclay|Ecole Normale Supérieure de Cachan]] from 1966 to 1969, when she took a teaching position there. In 1992 she moved to the University of Évry.{{r|bfs}}

==Books==
Jeanblanc is the author or coauthor of the books including
*''Enlargement of Filtration with Finance in View'' (with Anna Aksamit, Springer, 2017){{r|ef}}
*''Mathematical Methods for Financial Markets'' (with [[Marc Yor]] and Marc Chesney, Springer, 2009){{r|mm}}
*''Marchés financiers en temps continu: valorisation et équilibre'' (with Rose-Anne Dana, Economica, 1998), translated into English as ''Financial Markets in Continuous Time'' (Springer, 2003){{r|fm}}

==Recognition==
In 2009, Jeanblanc was made a chevalier in the [[Legion of Honour]].{{r|lh}}
